note: Read 2026-10-31 in archive.org's snapshot of 6 May 2026 of the Gaceta Oficial's own PDF of Gaceta Oficial No. 40 Ordinaria of 17 September 2010, which publishes Law 109 of 2010, the Código de Seguridad Vial (gacetaoficial.gob.cu gives this egress no answer). Art. 262: the learner's permit and the licence are issued, renewed, suspended or cancelled by the Ministry of the Interior, which sets their periods of expiry and renewal; art. 264(2): category B is motor vehicles under 3,500 kg with up to eight seats besides the driver's; art. 278: the licence is issued to 'personas mayores de 18 años' (the special military licence from 17, subcategory A-1 from 16). From 18 is my reading of 'mayores de 18 años' as 18 and over. The Gaceta's own page for Law 109 (archive.org snapshot of 13 February 2026, read) lists no norm modifying it. The term and the fee are null: the law leaves the periods to the Ministry and sets no fee (the stamps paid are the Ministry's, not read in any primary source; aggregator sites saying ten years and $15 in stamps per category for renewal weren't used).
